name: 13592-multiimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration; do not shard it.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16: 28-layer language model behind a 32-layer vision tower, spatial_merge_size 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 200 requests with a 1500 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat: ten distinct 1280x720 JPEGs plus ~100 text tokens per request, 32 output tokens.
purpose: A single-user photo analysis assistant reading ten 720p images per prompt with a 7B vision model on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested block is DROPPED by the engine's reader.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
# Above the ~12k-token request, so one request is one extend batch.
chunked-prefill-size: 32000
# No two requests share a prefix here, so the cache could only add bookkeeping.
disable-radix-cache: true
